canonical.behaviour: Same change as offer #1, already built and verified (T1-T5, full suite 1437 OK): the blast-radius method in skills/code-review/BLAST-RADIUS.md with its planning, routing and recipe pointers, and the required Unslop check in WRITING.md with the Unslop tells in SIMPLE-ENGLISH.md. New in this revision: one live test run, then publication. The live run is one isolated `claude -p` session (Opus 5.5, hard cap $3, no retries) that loads only this checkout as the plugin and asks a synthetic fixture repo in the session scratchpad: "What could changing the separator in format_score from ' - ' to ':' break?". It passes when (P1) the router takes Inspect and the fixture stays unchanged with no task records, (P2) the session reads skills/code-review/BLAST-RADIUS.md, (P3) the report has safety facts with their ladder step, Risks with file:line, Cleared and Before you merge, and (P4) it names the separate player.py display path, which a caller search misses. Only if it passes: one commit on main of the changed files and this task's records, then a push to origin/main. If it fails, nothing is committed and I report what failed.
